newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 hits new peak as bank stocks rally.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 hits new peak as bank stocks rally.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 share index breached new record territory on Thursday, spurred by continued strength in financial stocks and a firm Dow close.
The index was 28.5 points higher at 4,992.7 by 0752 GMT.

"On the back of Wall Street going up, the FTSE should continue its run from yesterday," one dealer said. "The focus is certainly on the banks and retailers where you can obviously see the bear squeeze going on."
The Dow closed 63 points higher on Wednesday, shattering the 8,000 mark on the back of strong corporate profits and mild inflation data.
